description: Read an integer VND amount in Vietnamese words, e.g. 1200000 -> "một triệu hai trăm nghìn đồng". Also reads plain numbers without a unit with plain: true, e.g. 30 -> "ba mươi". Reads ordinals with ordinal: true, e.g. 4 -> "thứ tư" (second "nhì"/"hai" for 2). Options: thousand "nghìn"/"ngàn", odd "lẻ"/"linh", capitalize, unit, lang "en" for English words (e.g. "one million two hundred thousand dong").

ordinal.description: Read an ordinal ("thứ nhất", "thứ tư"); integers >= 1, implies plain

plain.description: Read a plain number without a unit (default false); not with unit/chan

name: vn_money_to_words
title: Amount in Vietnamese words
